# X Post-First Template

## Flagship Standalone Post
- Start with a clear hook and one sharp claim.
- Add one concrete example or proof point.
- End with a simple CTA to the full post.

## Variant A: List Post
- Opening line with a specific promise.
- 3 short bullets with practical takeaways.
- Close with one line about who this helps.

## Variant B: Contrarian Post
- Start with a common belief to challenge.
- State the counterpoint clearly.
- Back it with one concrete detail.
- Close with a thoughtful prompt or CTA.

## Optional Continuation (Reply-Based)
- Reply 1: add extra context or an example.
- Reply 2: add a tradeoff or caveat.
- Reply 3: restate the takeaway and link.

## Style Rules
- Keep each post standalone and understandable without a thread.
- Use short lines, tight wording, and one idea per sentence.
- Favor specificity over hype.
